summary: Prepared a fixed, authenticated Admin recovery for the three sales whose line costs are supported by sale-time product fingerprints. Preview is no-store and digest-bound; apply requires backup_restore, a same-origin exact body, rate/body gates and a fresh backup, then restores four lines and allocations for sales 16951-16953 in one guarded D1 batch with an append-only durable receipt, non-reversible history and redacted provenance audit. Receipt-backed replay remains valid after legitimate later sale or stock activity, while immediate after-state read failures are reported honestly as verification_pending or HTTP 202 uncertain for exact-request replay. Sale 16951 alone deducts stock and records a sale movement because it is completed; awaiting sales 16952-16953 receive released allocations without stock effects. Sale 16952 keeps its later USD 2.70 fee/actual-cost edits and repairs only item-derived subtotal/total. Sale 16954 is reported as blocked because current product cost matches its pre-sale lot cost but the product row was updated after the sale, so sale-time product cost is not proven.

changes: Added migration 0145 with fixed-incident durable receipts, fixed-sale receipt members and a transient atomic guard; registered durable receipt tables in backup/restore and reset ordering, and made receipt/member rows append-only outside guarded restore/reset.

Added saleIncidentRecovery helper with exact target/snapshot/cost/product/lot/effect fingerprints, digest-bound preview, one D1 batch, strict stock subtraction, released awaiting allocations, durable receipt reconciliation, immediate postcondition verification and explicit unknown optional price fields.

Added authenticated no-store preview and backup-first same-origin apply routes with backup_restore permission, rate and body-size limits, post-commit cache/broadcast refresh, fixed success contracts and an explicit HTTP 202 uncertain contract for ambiguous post-commit receipt reads.

Added focused real-Hono migrated-SQLite coverage for permission, preview contract, exact apply/replay after later legitimate activity, stale sale and lot-label races, lost response, uncertain and verification-pending outcomes, rollback, backup failure, origin/body/rate gates, sale 16952 preservation and explicit null pricing metadata.
Added a read-only evidence compiler, preview contract validator, current production evidence summary, offline manifest and explicitly read-only pre/post SQL review queries.

evidence.claim: Sales 16951-16953 still matched the exact guarded production fingerprints at freeze time.
evidence.source: read-only production D1 query saved in the task transcript and sale-zero-items-recovery-current-evidence.json
evidence.locator: sale/product/positive-lot/effect/amendment result sets plus final concatenated guard query
evidence.observed: Sale revisions/updated_at were 1/03:19:13, 6/03:55:19.857Z and 1/04:14:55; all had zero items/allocations/sale movements. Product cost/stock and the four unique positive Shop lot fingerprints exactly matched the helper literals. Sale 16952 money guard was 2.7:2.7:0.0:0.0.

evidence.claim: Sale 16952 zero money is an itemless amendment fallout and its newer delivery edits are preserved.
evidence.observed: Amendment 13 moved actual delivery cost 2.60 to 2.70 while total stayed 299; amendment 14 moved delivery fee 2.60 to 2.70 while total fell 299 to 0. Recovery changes subtotal/total to 299 and leaves both newer 2.70 fields intact.

evidence.claim: Sale 16954 cannot yet use a proven sale-time product cost.
evidence.source: read-only production D1 product/lot/audit/history queries and sale-incident-fourth-header.json
evidence.locator: sale 16954; product 5370; positive lot 56737; empty audit/history/merge result sets
evidence.observed: Snapshot proves one unit at USD 185. Current product cost USD 170 matches lot 56737 unit cost USD 170, but products.updated_at is 06:11:40 after the 06:02:29 sale and no audit/history proves the product cost at sale time. The v1 preview therefore exposes 16954 as blocked and does not mutate it.

evidence.claim: Remote execution uses the Worker D1 batch primitive rather than raw SQL execution.
evidence.observed: The route prepares all sale/item/allocation/stock/movement/history/audit/receipt statements and submits them through one db.batch call after the backup succeeds; raw SQL output is labeled read-only.

evidence.claim: The durable receipt is the exact-once replay authority and is immutable during ordinary runtime.
evidence.locator: receipt/member append-only triggers; prepare and execute receipt branches
evidence.observed: Ordinary UPDATE/DELETE of receipts or members aborts; reset/restore must install the existing guarded system flag. A matching digest replays the stored response without comparing later mutable stock or sale revision values.

evidence.claim: Ambiguous post-commit reads do not claim rollback or silently complete.
evidence.observed: A successful batch with unavailable immediate after-state returns verification_pending; an ambiguous D1 response plus unavailable receipt read returns HTTP 202 uncertain with the operation and manifest identifiers for exact-request replay.

risks: The v1 helper intentionally fails closed if any sale, revision, product, stock or unique-positive-lot fingerprint changes before apply; a new reviewed manifest/code update would then be required.
Recovery-time lot attribution is recorded explicitly and is not represented as proof of the originally intended lot.
Sale 16954 remains itemless until a pre-sale product-cost source is found and a separate v2 recovery is reviewed.
Independent security/data-integrity review of exact runtime 5e61505c and full release gates are still required before migration 0145 or the Worker route can be deployed.
